description: The Chartered Institute of Media Professionals of Sri Lanka Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Policy approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-04-07 to prepare a Bill to establish the Chartered Institute of Media Professionals of Sri Lanka to meet the need for a training institution to conduct relevant studies with the aim of producing chartered media professionals and to raise the quality and standard of the media cohort in this country. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the final Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman for that purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to publish the Chartered Institute of Media Professionals of Sri Lanka Bill in the Government Gazette, and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
